sources.title: EUROCONTROL Data Snapshot #60: average flight in Europe
sources.scope: EUROCONTROL area, observed fleet mix; seats exclude military/cargo/business/other; NOT global demand forecast; traffic mix can change the aggregate.

sources.title: EUROCONTROL Seven-Year Forecast, Autumn 2026
sources.scope: External ECAC flight forecast, scenarios are conditional and not a route or passenger forecast. Full low/base/high range required; latest report supersedes Spring 2026.

sources.title: Airbus A321neo/A321LR technical page
sources.scope: OEM capability statements, not route-specific payload/range or full economic comparison. A321neo page range refers to LR variant; do not apply LR range to every A321neo.

sources.title: Airbus A321XLR technical page
sources.scope: Published maxima are not a simultaneous maximum-payload-and-range mission guarantee. Actual cabin, winds, reserve, alternate, runway and cargo matter.

sources.title: Iberia: one year with the A321XLR
sources.scope: Operator-reported network changes. New Brazil launches were plans at publication; not independent route profitability proof. Primary example demonstrates frequency plus seasonality plus route opening.

sources.title: Airbus A220 Family specifications
sources.scope: Current OEM page; maxima by configuration. New cabin 160 seats should not be treated as every existing operator layout.

sources.title: AirAsia orders 150 A220-300s
sources.scope: Firm order and stated network strategy; new cabin launch customer, not proof of deliveries, route success or earned profit.

sources.title: airBaltic condensed consolidated interim financial statements H1 2026
sources.scope: Whole-group H1 figures, seasonality and financing effects; not a causal estimate of A220 economics. Engine shortages in 2025 must not be described as still occurring in this operator in H1 2026.

sources.title: Boeing commercial product catalogue
sources.scope: Absence from current catalogue does not prove permanent cancellation. Treat NMA as unconfirmed hypothetical scenario; do not specify delivery year, purchase price or performance as available facts.

sources.title: Boeing: US FAA certifies 737-10
sources.scope: Manufacturer report of certification; do not imply an available near-term delivery slot for a new buyer or in-service fleet already established.

sources.title: Embraer E195-E2 specification
sources.scope: Used only for size-class alternative; dated PDF range not imported as a current maximum. Manufacturer source required when updating performance.

sources.title: ATR 72-600 specifications
sources.scope: Manufacturer nominal performance, not dispatch planning; preserve short thin regional class rather than assuming all new routes need A220.

algebra.annual_aggregation: sum passenger/seat/flight counts before computing ratios; same reporter intersection and pair cohort
algebra.profit_gate: passenger revenue + ancillary + cargo - full route cost; compare fleet commonality, seasonal utilisation, lease, reserves and reliability at each feasible frequency

no_claims: No global shift share is estimated from the five-country 2005-2024 panel.
No airline profitability ranking is justified by aircraft type alone.
NMA has no confirmed availability input in this evidence set.
No link between published manufacturer per-seat fuel percentage and route net profit is inferred.
